attempts: Ran separate English and French first-party discovery queries.
Fetched the official public viewer anonymously over TLS and followed its current Angular JavaScript configuration.
Fetched ArcGIS MapServer service metadata and layer 8 metadata; confirmed EPSG:2154, query capability, parcel layer name, and native identity fields.
Queried layer 8 at the exact immutable WUP point [43.6987107905202, 7.23303214314509] using inSR=4326 and outSR=4326; one polygon returned HTTP 200 GeoJSON.
Verified returned native identity CODEIDENT `060088   MT0022`, with CODCOMM `060088` and IDENT `   MT0022`; retained only canonical id in sample properties.
Fetched the official open-data catalog page and recorded its GeoJSON/Shapefile resource metadata.
Did not shift coordinates, log in, use credentials/private tokens, defeat access controls, request owner/titleholder/personal/contact/address/account data, or retain raw source attributes.
